verses.t: By the sky and the night comer
verses.pickthall: By the heaven and the Morning Star
verses.yusufAli: By the Sky and the Night-Visitant (therein)
verses.rodwell: BY the heaven, and by the NIGHT-COMER
verses.sale: By the heaven, and that which appeareth by night

verses.t: And what can make you know what is the night comer
verses.pickthall: Ah, what will tell thee what the Morning Star is
verses.yusufAli: And what will explain to thee what the Night-Visitant is
verses.rodwell: But who shall teach thee what the night-comer is
verses.sale: But what shall cause thee to understand what that which appeareth by night is

verses.yusufAli: (It is) the Star of piercing brightness
verses.rodwell: Tis the star of piercing radiance
verses.sale: It is the star of piercing brightness

verses.t: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector
verses.pickthall: No human soul but hath a guardian over it
verses.yusufAli: There is no soul but has a protector over it
verses.rodwell: Over every soul is set a guardian
verses.sale: Every soul hath a guardian set over it

verses.t: So let man observe from what he was created
verses.pickthall: So let man consider from what he is created
verses.yusufAli: Now let man but think from what he is created
verses.rodwell: Let man then reflect out of what he was created
verses.sale: Let a man consider, therefore, of what he is created

verses.t: He was created from a fluid, ejected
verses.pickthall: He is created from a gushing fluid
verses.yusufAli: He is created from a drop emitted
verses.rodwell: He was created of the poured-forth germs
verses.sale: He is created of seed poured forth

verses.t: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs
verses.pickthall: That issued from between the loins and ribs
verses.yusufAli: Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs
verses.rodwell: Which issue from the loins and breastbones
verses.sale: issuing from the loins, and the breast-bones

verses.t: Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able
verses.pickthall: Lo! He verily is Able to return him (unto life)
verses.yusufAli: Surely (Allah) is able to bring him back (to life)
verses.rodwell: Well able then is God to restore him to life
verses.sale: Verily God is able to restore him to life

verses.t: The Day when secrets will be put on trial
verses.pickthall: On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out
verses.yusufAli: The Day that (all) things secret will be tested
verses.rodwell: On the day when all secrets shall be searched out
verses.sale: the day whereon all secret thoughts and actions shall be examined into

verses.t: Then man will have no power or any helper
verses.pickthall: Then will he have no might nor any helper
verses.yusufAli: (Man) will have no power, and no helper
verses.rodwell: And he shall have no other might or helper
verses.sale: and he shall have no power to defend himself, nor any protector

verses.pickthall: By the heaven which giveth the returning rain
verses.yusufAli: By the Firmament which returns (in its round)
verses.rodwell: I swear by the heaven which accomplisheth its cycle
verses.sale: By the heaven which returneth the rain

verses.t: And [by] the earth which cracks open
verses.pickthall: And the earth which splitteth (with the growth of trees and plants)
verses.yusufAli: And by the Earth which opens out (for the gushing of springs or the sprouting of vegetation)
verses.rodwell: And by the earth which openeth her bosom
verses.sale: and by the earth which openeth to let forth vegetables and springs

verses.t: Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement
verses.pickthall: Lo! this (Qur'an) is a conclusive word
verses.yusufAli: Behold this is the Word that distinguishes (Good from Evil)
verses.rodwell: That this Koran is a discriminating discourse
verses.sale: Verily this is a discourse distinguishing good from evil

verses.yusufAli: It is not a thing for amusement
verses.rodwell: And that it is not frivolous
verses.sale: and it is not composed with lightness

verses.t: Indeed, they are planning a plan
verses.pickthall: Lo! they plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)
verses.yusufAli: As for them, they are but plotting a scheme
verses.rodwell: They plot a plot against thee
verses.sale: Verily the infidels are laying a plot to frustrate my designs

verses.t: But I am planning a plan
verses.pickthall: And I plot a plot (against them)
verses.yusufAli: And I am planning a scheme
verses.rodwell: And I will plot a plot against them
verses.sale: But I will lay a plot for their ruin

verses.t: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile
verses.pickthall: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while
verses.yusufAli: Therefore grant a delay to the Unbelievers: Give respite to them gently (for awhile)
verses.rodwell: Deal calmly therefore with the infidels; leave them awhile alone
verses.sale: Wherefore, O prophet, bear with the unbelievers: Let them alone a while
